summary: Full-stack engineer who leads with frontend: building rich, stateful React/TypeScript interfaces backed by Python (FastAPI) and Node.js services on PostgreSQL. Built Refill Arena from zero to $1M+ revenue across 3,200+ brands in 190+ countries, owning the UI, relational schema, APIs and data pipelines. AI-native — I build daily with LLMs and agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to prototype fast and ship reliable, tested code, with strong data-modelling and query-optimisation instincts.

Designed retrieval and validation services over structured data, with automated tests and monitoring.
Built a consumer web app with Next.js/TypeScript and NestJS APIs on PostgreSQL; shipped a feature that raised engagement **40%**.

Built Refill Arena from zero to **$1M+ revenue** — owned the React front end, relational schema, REST APIs and high-throughput data ingestion across **3,200+ brands** / **190+ countries**.
Modelled and normalised data for search and reporting; kept services at **99.9% uptime** with automation and monitoring.
Improved backend performance **25%** through query optimisation and caching; built JWT auth and Stripe subscription flows.
Delivered features independently from requirements through deployment.
